name: DeskDrv
description: Overdriven compact analog console channel strip preamp with soft clipping and 3-band EQ.

params.name: Gain
params.explanation: Console mic-preamp Trim overload (0 = warm glue, 100 = crushed gabber/EBM).

params.name: Low
params.explanation: 100 Hz channel-strip Low shelf (50 = flat, 0 = cut, 100 = +10 dB boost).

params.name: Mid
params.explanation: 2.5 kHz channel-strip Mid bell (50 = flat, 0 = scoop, 100 = vocal bite).

params.name: High
params.explanation: 6.5 kHz channel-strip High shelf (50 = flat, 0 = dark, 100 = crisp air).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Parallel dry/wet blend (100 = full console strip).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Channel fader output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).
